title: Hakumei and Mikochi
synopsis:
Nine centimeters (3.5 inches) tall, the tiny girls Hakumei and Mikochi live in the forest. Living in a tiny house in a tree, riding insects and birds, and making umbrellas out of leaves, these tiny girls live a tiny life. Follow their tiny but lovely lives as they live their day to day in a fantastic world of tiny people and gods.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

episodes.title: Kinou no Akane / Funauta no Ichiba
episodes.synopsis: As Hakumei and Mikochi go on with their daily lives they find little wonders of their world, and learn to find joy in each other’s company.

episodes.title: The Two Songstresses / The Glass Lamp / A Cup of Coffee
episodes.synopsis: Mikochi is chosen to be a songstress and she must learn how to deal with the new attention. Meanwhile, an unexpected gift arrives.

episodes.title: Starlit Sky and Ponkan / Work Day
episodes.synopsis: An unfortunate incident leaves Hakumei and Mikochi without a home. Later, Hakumei is hard at work when suddenly trouble arises.

episodes.title: Work Day 2 / Horned Owls and Old Tales
episodes.synopsis: Konju and Mikochi enjoy each other’s company while baking and crafting. Later, a usual trip to the mountains take a dangerous turn for the worst.

episodes.title: The Association's Work Site /  Large Stones and Joint Stones
episodes.synopsis: After a landslide causes a stone wall to collapse, Hakumei tries to lend a helping hand. Will Hakumei’s hard work and dedication get her noticed?

episodes.title: The Egg Beautician / A Day Off / The Egg Beautician - Day 2
episodes.synopsis: Hakumei finds an egg-shaped house with an unexpected resident, and the surprises continue when Iwashi agrees to go on an outing with the girls.

episodes.title: A Ladder in the Tree / The Metropolitan Lifestyle / Photo of a Smile
episodes.synopsis: A ladder above Hakumei and Mikochi’s home leads to many mysteries. One of them is an unexpected new resident that differs from the rest…

episodes.title: A Long Day
episodes.synopsis: The Honey House is home to many residents who aren't too fond of newcomers. Despite this, Konju plans to host a concert there which causes a bit of trouble for the girls.

episodes.title: Rhythm of the River Bottom / Dry Goods of the Stubborn
episodes.synopsis: Hakumei and Mikochi help Sen with important underwater research and later they feel inspired to design a new outfit for a friend.

episodes.title: Hot Bamboo Bath / Daikon and Pipes
episodes.synopsis: There's nothing more relaxing that a day at the spa even if it's followed by some unexpected company!

episodes.title: Overnight Train / Rain and Tenkara
episodes.synopsis: All aboard! Hakumei and Mikochi take a train to enjoy some fishing and find that the fish are harder to catch than they first thought.
